items.q: Is the self-hosted version really free?
items.a: Yes — for your own wedding or any event you don't charge for. It is not free for commercial use.
Charging someone to host, configure or run a my-boda site, or using it as part of a paid service. Planners, agencies and hosts need the commercial license.

items.q: What happens after the 12 months of Hosted Pro?
items.a: Hosting runs for 12 months from setup. We'll email you before the term ends: you can renew, or export your data and move to self-hosting.

items.q: Can I move between hosted and self-hosted?
items.a: Yes. Your data can be exported and the same code runs anywhere.
No. One price per site, unlimited guests, on every plan.
Email us and we'll send the invoice and the next steps.

items.q: What's the difference between Hosted Pro and Premium?
items.a: Premium adds a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA (with one free month if we miss it), priority support with a 24-hour reply target, a 30-minute setup call, and guest-list CSV import. Pro is the same hosted site without those extras.
